_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Udlala iKlondike Solitaire. Injongo yakho kukususa zonke ikhadi kwiinduli ezisezantsi.

Imithetho yeGame:
- Iinduli ezisezantsi (F1-F4): Yakha ukusuka kwiAce ukuya kwiKing ngokwekhadi
- Iinduli zeTableau (T1-T7): Yakha ukusuka phezulu ukuya phantsi ngokwekhadi zoluntu (ebomvu phezu kombala, kombala phezu kebomvu)
- IStock: Sosa ikhadi ukuya kwipile yasekhusini
- Ipile yasekhusini (W): Ikhadi ephakanyisiweyo ekhona ukudlala

Izwi Lawa:
- 'draw' - Sosa ikhadi ukusuka kwiStock ukuya kwipile yasekhusini
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Sosa ikhadi phakathi kweenduli
  Iziqondiso: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza ukuba 'all', eyakha ukususa zonke ikhadi ezibonisiweyo.
- 'forfeit' - Qeda umdlalo ngokukhawuleza ukususa iskoru yakho yamanje
- Amagama azeenduli: W (ekhusini), F1-F4 (ezisezantsi), T1-T7 (zeTableau)

Ungakwazi ukwenza zintathu ngezwi lawa ngokuhlukanisa zintathu ngekoma:
  Isiqondiso: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Iikhadi zeKing kuphela ezinaweza ukubekwa kwiinduli zeTableau ezingenazikhadi.
Izwi lawa zithatha ngokulandelana - ukuba inye iwe yaphelile, izwi lawa zilishiyekile zingasali.
Sebenzisa 'forfeit' ukuba ucinga umdlalo awunakwenzeka ukunqoba.
